name: scripts
//: The repository's scripts — setup and session provisioning, the Nx wrapper and explicit-base helper, packaging (dist.sh, install.sh), the bench and profile drivers, and the scripts other projects run (the schema validator, the e2e-matrix drift gate, the live harness suites, the skill install check), which those projects list as inputs. lint syntax-checks every shell script; test drives the scripts the gate and setup depend on as subprocesses (tests/). Its own project so a script change never reruns the crate's suites.
